Detailed Description

Lightweight POD structs for ADM and BSSN variables used when importing external metrics.

Initial-data utilities (e.g., metric splitting, Bowen–York solvers) use these containers to pass \((\alpha,\beta^i,\gamma_{ij})\) tuples through analytic construction code before populating the structure-of-arrays grid. The tensors employ row-major storage consistent with the rest of the Tensorium core.
